_comment: REAL, UNEDITED playerRosterStatus response from MFL, captured 2026-08-10
for L=74598 FID=0008 via a one-off commish probe (removed in the same
change that added this file). Committed because the parser in
worker/src/index.js (_lineupParseRosterStatuses) is written against this
exact shape, and the probe that produced it is gone — without a fixture
there would be no way left to re-verify or regression-test it.
Precedent for keeping it: _wvNormalizePendingWaivers in the same file was
written against several GUESSED shapes and got every one of them wrong,
because the populated payload had never been observed.
Two properties of this payload the parser must survive, both visible below:
1. KEY ORDER VARIES between entries — some put "id" first, some put
"roster_franchise" first; inside roster_franchise, "status" and
"franchise_id" also swap. Parse by key NAME, never by position.
2. status is R | S | NS | IR | TS. S = starter. Per MFL's docs, R is
returned only when no lineup is submitted OR the caller cannot see
the lineup — those two are indistinguishable here, which is why an
all-R answer read with a non-owner identity must not be reported as
"no lineup".
Truncated to 12 of the 38 entries for readability; the full response was
18 S / 17 NS / 3 TS, and 18 is exactly this league's starting-slot count.
The three TS rows are included so taxi handling stays covered.
